summary: Defines a certificate extension that links together a set of certificates belonging to the same end entity that can be treated as equivalent. Applications that keep state tied to a certificate can then recognize a renewed or reissued one. It is Experimental.

eli5.summary: If you replace your library card, the library should still know it is you. This extension lets a certificate point to other certificates for the same owner, so saved information is not lost.
